reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Nebraska
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that eviction was retaliatory?
*/

% ---------------------------
% Utility predicates
% ---------------------------

% after(Date2, Date1) is true when Date2 occurs after Date1.
% We model dates as comparable numbers for determinism in this QA setting.
after(Date2, Date1) :-
    number(Date2),
    number(Date1),
    Date2 > Date1.

% ---------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement encoded)
% ---------------------------

% Parties / action
tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).
possession_action(a1).                 % eviction action = action for possession
action_parties(a1, l1, t1).

% Tenant's protected activity: complaint to a government agency about a minimum housing/building code
% violation materially affecting health and safety (NE  76-1439(1)(a)).
government_agency(agency1).
complaint_to_agency(t1, agency1, min_housing_code_violation, materially_affecting_health_safety, 1).

% Landlord brings an action for possession after the tenant's complaint (NE  76-1439(1)).
landlord_brought_action_for_possession(l1, t1, a1, 2).

% Tenant attempts to raise the retaliation defense in the eviction action.
tenant_raises_defense(t1, a1, retaliatory_eviction).

% Exceptions (NE  76-1439(3)) - scenario specifies none apply.
% These are explicitly negated by absence; we encode as facts showing they do NOT apply.
tenant_default_in_rent(t1, no).
code_violation_caused_by_tenant_lack_reasonable_care(t1, no).
code_compliance_requires_alteration_remodel_demolition_depriving_use(t1, no).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario is satisfied (reusable summary).
scenario_statement :-
    possession_action(a1),
    action_parties(a1, l1, t1),
    tenant_raises_defense(t1, a1, retaliatory_eviction),
    complaint_to_agency(t1, agency1, min_housing_code_violation, materially_affecting_health_safety, ComplaintDate),
    landlord_brought_action_for_possession(l1, t1, a1, ActionDate),
    after(ActionDate, ComplaintDate),
    tenant_default_in_rent(t1, no),
    code_violation_caused_by_tenant_lack_reasonable_care(t1, no),
    code_compliance_requires_alteration_remodel_demolition_depriving_use(t1, no).

% ---------------------------
% Statute encodings (Nebraska, 2021)
% ---------------------------

/* NE Code  76-1439 (2021) - Retaliatory conduct prohibited. */

% Protected activity under  76-1439(1)(a): complaint to a government agency about a minimum code violation
% materially affecting health/safety.
statute_761439_protected_activity(Tenant, complained_to_agency(CodeType, Materiality), Date) :-
    complaint_to_agency(Tenant, _Agency, CodeType, Materiality, Date).

% Protected activity under  76-1439(1)(b): organized or became member of tenants' union.
% (Not used in this scenario; included for completeness.)
statute_761439_protected_activity(Tenant, joined_tenants_union, Date) :-
    tenants_union_membership(Tenant, Date).

% Landlord retaliates under  76-1439(1) by bringing or threatening to bring an action for possession after
% protected activity.
statute_761439_retaliatory_act(Landlord, Tenant, bring_action_for_possession(Action), ActDate) :-
    landlord_brought_action_for_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Action, ActDate).

% (Also prohibited by statute but not used in this scenario: increasing rent or decreasing services)
statute_761439_retaliatory_act(Landlord, Tenant, increased_rent, ActDate) :-
    landlord_increased_rent(Landlord, Tenant, ActDate).
statute_761439_retaliatory_act(Landlord, Tenant, decreased_services, ActDate) :-
    landlord_decreased_services(Landlord, Tenant, ActDate).

% Exception to retaliation rule under  76-1439(3)(a): code violation primarily caused by tenant lack of care.
statute_761439_exception_applies(Tenant, caused_by_tenant_lack_reasonable_care) :-
    code_violation_caused_by_tenant_lack_reasonable_care(Tenant, yes).

% Exception under  76-1439(3)(b): tenant is in default in rent.
statute_761439_exception_applies(Tenant, tenant_in_default_in_rent) :-
    tenant_default_in_rent(Tenant, yes).

% Exception under  76-1439(3)(c): compliance requires alteration/remodel/demolition depriving tenant of use.
statute_761439_exception_applies(Tenant, alteration_remodel_demolition_depriving_use) :-
    code_compliance_requires_alteration_remodel_demolition_depriving_use(Tenant, yes).

% Violation of  76-1439(1) exists when landlord performs retaliatory act after protected activity,
% and no  76-1439(3) exception applies.
statute_761439_violation(Landlord, Tenant, Action) :-
    statute_761439_protected_activity(Tenant, _Protected, ProtectedDate),
    statute_761439_retaliatory_act(Landlord, Tenant, bring_action_for_possession(Action), ActDate),
    after(ActDate, ProtectedDate),
    \+ statute_761439_exception_applies(Tenant, _AnyException).

%  76-1439(2): if landlord violates subsection (1), tenant "has a defense in action ... for possession."
statute_761439_defense_in_possession_action(Tenant, Action) :-
    action_parties(Action, Landlord, Tenant),
    possession_action(Action),
    statute_761439_violation(Landlord, Tenant, Action).

/* NE Code  76-1430 (2021) - Tenant's remedies for landlord's unlawful ouster/exclusion/diminution of service. */

% Encodes the availability of remedies; details (3 months rent + attorney fee) represented structurally.
statute_761430_remedy_available(Tenant, recover_possession, liquidated_damages(three_months_rent), attorney_fee(reasonable)) :-
    landlord_unlawfully_removed_or_excluded(Tenant, yes).
statute_761430_remedy_available(Tenant, terminate_rental_agreement, liquidated_damages(three_months_rent), attorney_fee(reasonable)) :-
    landlord_unlawfully_removed_or_excluded(Tenant, yes).
statute_761430_remedy_available(Tenant, recover_possession, liquidated_damages(three_months_rent), attorney_fee(reasonable)) :-
    landlord_willfully_wrongfully_diminished_essential_services(Tenant, yes).
statute_761430_remedy_available(Tenant, terminate_rental_agreement, liquidated_damages(three_months_rent), attorney_fee(reasonable)) :-
    landlord_willfully_wrongfully_diminished_essential_services(Tenant, yes).

/* NE Code  76-1428 (2021) - Landlord's noncompliance as defense to action for possession (limited encoding). */

% Tenant may counterclaim/defend in a possession action based on nonpayment of rent (or action for rent while in possession).
statute_761428_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action, Tenant) :-
    possession_action(Action),
    action_parties(Action, _Landlord, Tenant),
    action_basis(Action, nonpayment_of_rent),
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, yes).
statute_761428_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action, Tenant) :-
    action_for_rent(Action),
    action_parties(Action, _Landlord, Tenant),
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, yes).

% If after applying offsets no rent remains due, judgment entered for tenant in possession action.
statute_761428_judgment_for_tenant_if_no_rent_due(Action, Tenant) :-
    statute_761428_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action, Tenant),
    net_rent_due_after_offsets(Action, Tenant, 0).

% If defense/counterclaim without merit and not in good faith, landlord may recover reasonable attorney fees.
statute_761428_landlord_attorney_fees_if_bad_faith(Action, Landlord) :-
    action_parties(Action, Landlord, Tenant),
    statute_761428_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action, Tenant),
    defense_without_merit_and_not_good_faith(Action, Tenant, yes).

/* NE Code  76-1419 (2021) - Landlord to maintain fit premises (duty list encoding). */

statute_761419_landlord_duty(landlord, comply_with_minimum_housing_codes_after_notice).
statute_761419_landlord_duty(landlord, make_repairs_to_keep_fit_and_habitable_after_notice).
statute_761419_landlord_duty(landlord, keep_common_areas_clean_and_safe).
statute_761419_landlord_duty(landlord, maintain_facilities_electrical_plumbing_sanitary_heating_etc).
statute_761419_landlord_duty(landlord, provide_receptacles_and_arrange_removal_of_waste).
statute_761419_landlord_duty(landlord, supply_running_water_hot_water_reasonable_heat_subject_to_exceptions).

/* NE Code  76-1431 (2021) - Noncompliance; failure to pay rent; termination notices; violent criminal activity. */

% (1) Tenant material noncompliance: notice, 14-day cure, termination date >= 30 days after receipt.
statute_761431_terminate_for_material_noncompliance(NoticeDate, TerminationDate) :-
    number(NoticeDate),
    number(TerminationDate),
    TerminationDate >= NoticeDate + 30.

statute_761431_cure_period_material_noncompliance(CureDays) :-
    CureDays = 14.

% (2) Unpaid rent: 7 calendar days after written notice to pay.
statute_761431_rent_default_cure_period(CureDays) :-
    CureDays = 7.

% (4) Violent criminal activity etc.: 5 days' written notice of termination and no right to cure.
statute_761431_violent_activity_notice_period(NoCureNoticeDays) :-
    NoCureNoticeDays = 5.

% ---------------------------
% Reasoning: apply statute to scenario
% ---------------------------

% Tenant can raise retaliation defense in the eviction action if  76-1439(2) defense applies.
tenant_can_raise_retaliation_defense_in_eviction(Action, Tenant) :-
    statute_761439_defense_in_possession_action(Tenant, Action).

% ---------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
% ---------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    tenant_can_raise_retaliation_defense_in_eviction(a1, t1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% ---------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% ---------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that eviction was retaliatory?
